after3_start.name: {name}
after3_start.text: *After school. My mind is a mess. Who should I go to first?*

after3_route_check.name: {name}
after3_route_check.text: *I check my phone. No reply, and the meeting time is just getting closer.*

after3_auto_dain.name: {name}
after3_auto_dain.text: *I have plans with Dain. Heading to the gym.*

after3_auto_yuna.name: {name}
after3_auto_yuna.text: *I have plans with Yuna. Heading to the library annex.*

after3_auto_seo.name: {name}
after3_auto_seo.text: *I have plans with Seoyeon. Heading to the student council room.*

after3_multi_choice.name: {name}
after3_multi_choice.text: *My plans overlapped. To be precise, I made them overlap. Running away would be even worse. Who should I go to first to fix this?*

after3_reject_for_seo_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_1.text: *I run into Dain in the hallway. Her usual energy is gone. The smile doesn't come first today.*

after3_reject_for_seo_2.name: Dain
after3_reject_for_seo_2.text: ...You're not coming to the gym today, are you?

after3_reject_for_seo_3.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_3.text: *I pass by the library. Yuna's seat is empty. One note remains. '...Okay.' Too short. The edge of the paper is slightly crumpled.*

after3_reject_for_seo_4.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_4.text: *I step back into the hallway. Dain's sentence without exclamation marks, Yuna's too-short note with a crumpled edge. — The weight of my choice settles on my shoulders.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_1.text: *Seoyeon is organizing her clipboard in the hallway. Her hands turn the pages faster than usual.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_yuna_2.text: Student council work is busy. I'll eat separately. ...Today.

after3_reject_for_yuna_walk_gym.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_walk_gym.text: *My feet carry me toward the gym.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_3.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_3.text: *Dain is hitting balls alone in the gym.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_3_react.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_3_react.text: *But she turns her face away. Her eyes are red.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_4.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_4.text: *I leave the gym and return to the hallway. Seoyeon pretended she was fine. Dain couldn't even do that. — Somehow, both hurt more that way.*

after3_reject_for_dain_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_dain_1.text: *Seoyeon is organizing her clipboard. She's smiling, but the fingers doing the organizing are too neat, too controlled.*

after3_reject_for_dain_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_dain_2.text: ...I have some things to do today. I'll head out first.

after3_reject_for_dain_3.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_dain_3.text: *There is no note in the library. Yuna's bag is gone too. Only a lukewarm water ring remains on the desk, like she was here just moments ago.*

after3_seo_1.name: {name}
after3_seo_1.text: *I opened the student council room door. — Seoyeon is slumped over the desk.*

after3_seo_3.name: {name}
after3_seo_3.text: *Seoyeon lifts her head at the sound of someone entering. Her eyes look tired. Her makeup is slightly smudged.*

after3_seo_7.name: {name}
after3_seo_7.text: See what? I didn't see anything.

after3_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_8.text: This side of me. — This is a secret.

after3_seo_9.name: {name}
after3_seo_9.text: *Seoyeon straightens her posture. But — her usual perfect smile doesn’t return.*

after3_seo_choice.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_choice.text: Next time I ask you for a favor, you have to say yes. No questions asked. — Consider it payment.
choices: You don’t have to be perfect, you know

after3_seo_choice1.name: {name}
after3_seo_choice1.text: *Seoyeon pauses. Sets down her pen. Slowly.*

after3_seo_choice1_react.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_choice1_react.text: ...Words like that. You shouldn’t say them so easily.

after3_seo_choice2.name: {name}
after3_seo_choice2.text: *Her eyes are glistening. — She didn’t cry. Not yet.*

after3_seo_end.name: {name}
after3_seo_end.text: *Those words carry weight. — I think I’m starting to understand how monumental it is for this person to show an imperfect side of herself.*

after3_seo_end_c2.name: {name}
after3_seo_end_c2.text: *Promising to keep her secret — seems to mean a great deal to this person.*

after3_yuna_1.name: {name}
after3_yuna_1.text: *The library annex. Yuna’s secret reading nook. — The door is open.*

after3_yuna_2.name: {name}
after3_yuna_2.text: *I go in, but Yuna isn’t here. Instead — a notebook lies open on the sofa. Filled with handwriting.*

after3_yuna_7.name: {name}
after3_yuna_7.text: *Yuna’s voice from behind. I turn around and she’s standing there holding two drinks. — She freezes when she sees me looking at the notebook.*

after3_yuna_8b.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_8b.text: *Quickly approaches and snatches the notebook* ...I didn't say you could.

after3_yuna_9.name: {name}
after3_yuna_9.text: *Her ears. Red. — It’s the first time I’ve seen Yuna blush.*

after3_yuna_choice.name: {name}
choices: You might want to change the protagonist’s name though

after3_yuna_choice1_2.name: {name}
after3_yuna_choice1_2.text: ’A transfer student came to the library’ is just a coincidence?

after3_yuna_choice1_3.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_choice1_3.text: *Flips the notebook closed* ...But sometimes. Fiction can be more honest than reality.

after3_yuna_choice1_react.name: {name}
after3_yuna_choice1_react.text: *She said fiction, but her ears are lying.*

after3_yuna_choice2.name: {name}
after3_yuna_choice2.text: *Yuna pauses. She looks down at the notebook.*

after3_yuna_choice2_2.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_choice2_2.text: ...I haven’t decided on the ending yet.

after3_yuna_choice2_3.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_choice2_3.text: ...Because once I write the ending, it’s over.

after3_yuna_choice2_react.name: {name}
after3_yuna_choice2_react.text: *Yuna spoke more than two sentences in a row. — For her, that’s proof of emotion.*

after3_yuna_end.name: {name}
after3_yuna_end.text: *Yuna clutches the notebook tightly to her chest.*

after3_dain_1.name: {name}
after3_dain_1.text: *The gym. Dain is stretching alone. She tries a light jog and —*

after3_dain_4.name: Dain
after3_dain_4.text: Ah! I’m fine!! It’s just a little twist!!

after3_dain_6.name: {name}
after3_dain_6.text: *Too many exclamation marks. — Way too many. Does this girl use more exclamation marks when she’s not okay?*

after3_dain_choice.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice.text: *Dain sits on the bench. She rubs her knee.*
choices: Sit next to her and wait quietly
Got any patches? I’ll go get them

after3_dain_choice1.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1.text: *I sit beside her without a word. Dain glances my way.*

after3_dain_choice1_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1_3.text: Because you’d just say you’re fine.

after3_dain_choice1_react.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1_react.text: *Dain hesitates. — Then smiles, small. A smile I've never seen before.*

after3_dain_choice2.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice2.text: Hey! I’m fine! I don’t need a bandage or anything!!

after3_dain_end.name: {name}
after3_dain_end.text: *Dain lightly punches my shoulder with her fist. — Weaker than yesterday.*

after3_dain_end_first.name: {name}
after3_dain_end_first.text: *Dain lightly punches my shoulder. — She seems embarrassed.*

after3_confront_1.name: {name}
after3_confront_1.text: *Coming out of the after-school spot — Seoyeon is waiting in the hallway. Arms crossed. Her usual composure is gone.*

after3_confront_3.name: {name}
after3_confront_3.text: *Seoyeon leads me to the end of the hallway. Where no one else is.*

after3_confront_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_5.text: When you smiled the same way at other people, I kind of hated it.

after3_confront_6.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_6.text: Be honest. Did you promise all of us the weekend?

after3_confront_choice.name: {name}
after3_confront_choice.text: *Seoyeon looks straight at me. Not with the eyes of a student council president. With the eyes of just a person.*
choices: The time slots are different, so I thought it would be fine
You’re the only one I’m serious about

after3_confront_admit_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_2.text: That’s the cruelest thing you can say, {name}. Kindness that can’t refuse — gives people false hope.

after3_confront_admit_3.name: {name}
after3_confront_admit_3.text: *Seoyeon picks up her lunch bag. Her hands are trembling.*

after3_confront_admit_4.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_4.text: You told me I didn’t have to be perfect — and then you tried to be the perfect person for everyone. That’s worse.

after3_confront_admit_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_5.text: ...I won’t be leaving the rooftop open today.

after3_confront_admit_6.name: {name}
after3_confront_admit_6.text: *Her back is straight. Perfectly. — But her fists are clenched. Her knuckles are white.*

after3_confront_excuse.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse.text: ...You don’t see how that’s the problem?

after3_confront_excuse_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse_2.text: It's not about how many people you made plans with. It's about what that promise meant to me.

after3_confront_lie_2.name: {name}
after3_confront_lie_2.text: *Eyes that want to believe. — I didn’t know a lie could weigh this much.*

after3_confront_end.name: {name}
after3_confront_end.text: *I’m standing alone in the hallway where Seoyeon disappeared. — Her posture was straight. Perfectly straight. But her fists were clenched.*

after3_final.name: {name}
after3_final.text: *After school is over. — What I saw today won’t leave my mind.*

haeun_warn_1.name: {name}
haeun_warn_1.text: *I stepped out of the student council room. The hallway is empty. — Someone was waiting.*

haeun_warn_3.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_3.text: Did you just see Seoyeon? My senior?

haeun_warn_4.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_4.text: ...She cried. After she left the student council room. In the bathroom. — I was the only one who saw. In a whole year, I've never seen her cry.

haeun_warn_5.name: {name}
haeun_warn_5.text: *Seoyeon cried. — All she said to me was that I'd 'seen her imperfect side.' But after that, she cried.*

haeun_warn_5b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_5b.text: Sunbae is someone who thinks she has to be perfect. Someone who thinks crying means losing.

haeun_warn_6.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_6.text: The fact that she cried — that means she really cares about you, {name}.

haeun_warn_7.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7.text: I know I'm butting in. But I'm worried about her. — Things at home are complicated for her right now. Her parents are... ...anyway. Please be good to her. I'm asking you.

haeun_warn_8.name: {name}
haeun_warn_8.text: *I can't get the image out of my head — Seoyeon crying alone in the bathroom. That perfectly straight back, those white-knuckled fists, and — an empty bathroom.*

haeun_warn_8b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_8b.text: *I walked out to the school entrance.*

minsu_d3_1.name: {name}
minsu_d3_1.text: *Walking home. Minsu is waiting at the school gate.*

minsu_d3_3.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_3.text: At lunch. And just now, Seoyeon's face.

minsu_d3_4.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_4.text: What did I tell you yesterday? 'If all three of them end up crying, that's on you.' That wasn't supposed to be 'later.' It's now.

minsu_d3_5.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_5.text: Man, it's hard to watch from the sidelines too. They're all good people. — I know you're not doing this because you're a bad guy. You just can't say no.

minsu_d3_5b.name: {name}
minsu_d3_5b.text: *Minsu sighs. Not out of contempt — out of genuine concern.*

minsu_d3_6.name: {name}
minsu_d3_6.text: ...But I don't know what I'm supposed to do.

minsu_d3_6b.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_6b.text: I won't ask what happened at your old school. But let me tell you one thing.

minsu_d3_7.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_7.text: Saying no is also a form of love. Turning someone down when it's not going to work — that's a hundred times better than giving them false hope.

minsu_d3_8.name: {name}
minsu_d3_8.text: *...The flashback ends. Minsu taps his forehead with a finger.*

minsu_d3_9.name: {name}
minsu_d3_9.text: *In the end, the answer is simple. One person. That alone is enough.*

minsu_d3_10.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_10.text: See you at school tomorrow. — Seriously, think about it. For real.

after3_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_freetalk.text: *Standing face to face with Seoyeon in the hallway. Her expression is complicated.*
after3_seo_freetalk.context: Day 3 afterschool, right after confrontation/reconciliation with Seoyeon. Trust is shaken. Tone: Bright on the surface but shadows underneath. Sometimes smiling but eyes aren't. Sincerity peeks through casual conversation.
after3_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool student council president. Strong possessiveness, direct when jealous. Hurt but trying not to show it.

after3_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_freetalk.text: *Walking alongside Yuna. Her gaze is cool.*
after3_yuna_freetalk.context: Day 3 afterschool, just talked with Yuna. She's showing more emotion than usual. Tone: Bright on the surface but shadows underneath. Sometimes smiling but eyes aren't. Sincerity peeks through casual conversation.
after3_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a mysterious literary girl. Usually calm but emotionally shaken now. More about wanting confirmation than jealousy.

after3_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
after3_dain_freetalk.text: *Sitting on a bench with Dain at the playground. She's quieter than usual.*
after3_dain_freetalk.context: Day 3 afterschool, just talked with Dain. She's hurt but pretending to be cheerful. Tone: Bright on the surface but shadows underneath. Sometimes smiling but eyes aren't. Sincerity peeks through casual conversation.
after3_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic athlete. Being cheerful is her only defense. Fewer exclamation marks mean she's being real.

after3_seo_choice1_react_ins.name: {name}
after3_seo_choice1_react_ins.text: *Seoyeon looks out the window. I can't see her expression. — She's deliberately hiding it.*

after3_seo_choice1_react_ins3.name: {name}
after3_seo_choice1_react_ins3.text: *Seoyeon straightens up. The student council president's face returns. — But it's not perfect. The angle of her smile is off by half a degree.*

after3_seo_choice1_react_ins6.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_choice1_react_ins6.text: *Sorting through papers* I know one of your secrets too.

after3_seo_choice1_react_ins7.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_choice1_react_ins7.text: Your eyes lit up when you ate the rolled omelette at lunch. — You can't fake that.

after3_seo_choice1_react_ins8.name: {name}
after3_seo_choice1_react_ins8.text: *I offered to keep her secret, and she pulled out a secret of equal weight. — For this person, equality comes before gratitude.*

after3_yuna_choice1_2_ins.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_choice1_2_ins.text: *Clutching the notebook to her chest* ...Novels are. Fiction.

after3_yuna_choice2_3_ins.name: {name}
after3_yuna_choice2_3_ins.text: *Yuna spoke more than two sentences in a row. — I've never seen her say this much before.*

after3_seo_7_ins.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_7_ins.text: *Looks down* ...I really didn't want you to see this.

after3_dain_5_ins.name: Dain
after3_dain_5_ins.text: I told you I'm fine!! It's nothing!!

after3_dain_choice2_ins.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice2_ins.text: *Brought a bandage from the nurse’s office. Held it out to Dain.*

after3_dain_choice2_ins4.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice2_ins4.text: *Dain takes the bandage and stares at it for a long time. Bites her lip.*

after3_dain_choice2_ins5.name: Dain
after3_dain_choice2_ins5.text: *Smiles weakly.* ...What. I shouldn’t be moved by something like this.

after3_dain_choice2_ins6.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice2_ins6.text: *She accepted it. — This is the first time Dain hasn’t refused someone’s help. The smile without exclamation marks feels strangely heavy.*

after3_confront_5_ins.name: Dain
after3_confront_5_ins.text: *With her head lowered.* ...I didn't like it either.

after3_confront_5_ins2.name: {name}
after3_confront_5_ins2.text: *She accepted it. — This is the first time Dain hasn't refused someone's help. A smile without exclamation marks feels strangely heavy.*

haeun_warn_5c_ins.name: Seoyeon
haeun_warn_5c_ins.text: When you smiled the same way at other people, I kind of hated it.

after3_confront_excuse_ins.name: {name}
after3_confront_excuse_ins.text: *Seoyeon's eyes are cold. A temperature I've never seen before.*

after3_confront_lie_2_ins2.name: {name}
after3_confront_lie_2_ins2.text: *Her back is straight. Perfectly. — But her fists are clenched. Her knuckles are white.*

haeun_warn_1_ins.name: {name}
haeun_warn_1_ins.text: *Haeun is leaning against the wall. She's fiddling with her student council bracelet.*

haeun_warn_2_ins.name: {name}
haeun_warn_2_ins.text: Haeun? What are you doing here?

haeun_warn_7_ins.name: {name}
haeun_warn_7_ins.text: *Haeun stops herself. Her face says she knows she shouldn't cross the line.*

haeun_warn_7_ins2.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7_ins2.text: ...Anyway. Please be good to her. I'm asking you.

minsu_d3_4_ins2.name: Minsu
minsu_d3_4_ins2.text: Trying to be 'the good guy' by accepting everyone — that's not kindness, it's cowardice.

minsu_d3_7_ins.name: {name}
minsu_d3_7_ins.text: *Saying no is love. — At my old school, I never even gave Sojeong the chance to say 'no.' Because I couldn't say anything. She got a boyfriend without knowing how I felt, and I transferred with 38 unsent confessions saved in my phone's notes.*

minsu_d3_7_ins2.name: {name}
minsu_d3_7_ins2.text: *If Sojeong had been able to reject me back then — maybe it wouldn't still haunt me.*
